errors.evidence: BGBX40 is not visible in 2001; its visible series begins around 2014, and it is already around 100–120 on the right axis, not 50 in 2007.

The red line corresponds to BG40, but the description omits that BG40 is tied to the right axis only after 2005 and does not span the full 2001–2021 period, which can mislead the mapping of the series extent.
The green line corresponds to BGBX40, but the description incorrectly treats it as present across the whole 2001–2021 span rather than beginning around 2014.
The description does not mention that the plot uses two y-axes (left for SOFIX, right for BG40 and BGBX40) in a shared-axis layout.
